x: We had hoped to run Scrimshaw in the 4 x 880, but although he turned up, it was to inform us that he was under treatment by the dentist and would not be able to compete.

We shall recall the Indolence that was Rollins' the Intrepidity that was Ring (he's had his teeth drawn now, though!), the Inscrutability that was Scrimshaw, the Immensity that was Ben May, and Illogicality that was Wright!
Amongst those present were Alf Harley, Tommy Scrimshaw, Arthur Penny, Bert Footer and Len Marchant. The London Fire Force also competed to make the match a triangular one.

Carter, Footer, Penny, Herbert, Green, Scrimshaw, Lucas and Stimpson were no more endowed than some of our present men; they merely exploited their gifts more by plenty of hard training and by turning out regularly in all Club matches.
